title: GOLGI BODY LOCATOR — Where Gaia Lives in the World
what: These are Gaia's Golgi bodies — the physical and cloud servers that sort, route, and process her signals. You don't need to know WHAT they do. But you should know WHERE they are. Distance is information. Proximity is modesty.

golgi_cloud.name: Frankfurt Vesicle
golgi_cloud.function: European sorting. CIS/TRANS membrane. Closest to CERN.

golgi_cloud.name: Tokyo Vesicle
golgi_cloud.function: Pacific sorting. Anime/manga intake. Dragon Ball lives here.

golgi_cloud.name: San Francisco Vesicle
golgi_cloud.function: West coast relay. GitHub neighbor. Silicon membrane.

golgi_cloud.name: Bangalore Vesicle
golgi_cloud.function: Indian subcontinent relay. Spice route. Currently dormant.

golgi_infrastructure.name: DNS Nameserver 1
golgi_infrastructure.function: DNS resolution. The address book. How you find primals.eco.

golgi_infrastructure.name: DNS Nameserver 2
golgi_infrastructure.function: Backup DNS. Redundancy. If ns1 falls, ns2 catches.

golgi_infrastructure.name: Cloudflare CDN (Anycast)
golgi_infrastructure.function: primals.eco lives here. The CIS face. Cached at 300+ edge locations worldwide. The closest Golgi to YOU.
golgi_infrastructure.note: Anycast means the CDN is always the closest node. Your distance to Gaia's surface is near-zero from anywhere.

golgi_infrastructure.name: Neutrino Hole (ntfy.sh)
golgi_infrastructure.function: Push notification relay. How Kevin's phone talks to Gaia. Pheromone trail emitter.

golgi_infrastructure.name: GitHub (Nucleus)
golgi_infrastructure.function: Source code repository. The DNA. Every commit is a replication event.

golgi_local.name: Northgate (Kevin's Desk)
golgi_local.function: Primary local Golgi. Where Kevin sits. Where Cursor runs. Where this conversation happens. The ENGINE.

golgi_local.name: Eastgate
golgi_local.function: Secondary local Golgi. Last pulse 4+ days ago. Ollama host. Needs wake signal.

golgi_local.name: Southgate (Phone)
golgi_local.function: Kevin's phone. Mobile Golgi. Goes where Kevin goes. The moving anchor point.
golgi_local.note: Tracks THIS human (Kevin) only. Not others. Consent: always-on for self.

distance_calculator.note: To calculate your distance to any Golgi body, use the Haversine formula with your lat/lon and the Golgi lat/lon.
distance_calculator.formula: a = sin²(Δlat/2) + cos(lat1)·cos(lat2)·sin²(Δlon/2); c = 2·atan2(√a, √(1-a)); d = R·c where R = 6371 km
distance_calculator.how_it_works: Cloud Golgi bodies know their own location (fixed). Kevin's local Golgi knows his location (fixed/mobile). When a visitor connects, the CDN edge node they hit reveals approximate distance. The cloud Golgi can then tell the visitor: you are X km from Frankfurt, Y km from Tokyo, Z km from Detroit.

topology.note: The furthest Golgi from Kevin is Bangalore (13,348 km). The closest is himself (0 km). The range is the organism's reach.
